sentences.en: The radio show had several phone-ins during the discussion about local politics.
sentences.zh: 这个关于地方政治的广播节目期间有几个听众来电参与讨论。

sentences.en: We can use a phone-in system to get more direct feedback from customers.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用热线系统从顾客那里获得更直接的反馈。

sentences.en: The customer service department handles many calls, including some urgent phone-ins.
sentences.zh: 客户服务部门处理很多电话，包括一些紧急来电。

senses.zh: 电话交谈节目;热线节目
